description: PyPI-published agents installed with uv - the ecosystem the query used to miss entirely.
why: pipx and uv tool directories were already product-free globs and are unchanged. python_packages stays out of the query at 15.6s with no WHERE push-down, so these globs are the only thing standing between us and an invisible PyPI ecosystem. file >= 3 because Hermes arrives twice under enumeration -- the uv tool directory named for the package, `hermes-agent`, and the `hermes` command uv writes into ~/.local/bin -- and those are two different catalog routes reading the same install. It is a floor, not an equality: uv writes three commands and the state directory may or may not appear on first run, and neither count is ours to predict.
